renderer: R2-repaired baseline surface renderer + shared Actor-Visible Expression Hygiene; PSSB forbidden
expression_hygiene: Prefer playable gaze/eyes/mouth/jaw/brow/breath/posture/tension/hands/object-handling/distance/timing/silence/hesitation/interruption over direct emotion labels when stageable.
Show facial-expression change as a readable progression tied to the licensed scene cause/turn/exit, not as a quota of micro-expressions.
Do not have dialogue explain an emotion already legible in behavior/expression.
Expression may reveal only already-licensed state; no new motive/backstory/event/decision/future-thread.

scale_guidance.purpose: avoid known under-scale failure before full-arm completion

semantic_rules: Exactly five licensed scenes per sequence.
Preserve each scene goal/obstacle/turn/exit and event ownership.
No new event, cause, decision-owner, future-owner, second-order obligation or future-adoption mutation.
No PSSB-specific systematic binding intervention in Control.
execution_order: SQ01 through SQ10; checkpoint after SQ05; run scale/hygiene gate before Treatment.
